

## **3\. User Manual** {#3.-user-manual}

### **3.1 Overview** {#3.1-overview}

**Fast F\&B** is an e-commerce platform designed to provide quick and efficient delivery of hot fast food and fresh produce within local communities. It aims to connect local suppliers and consumers, ensuring fast, fresh, and safe food delivery.

**Key Features**:

* **Account Management**: Register, log in, and manage user profiles.  
* **Product Management**: View, add, and edit products for shopkeepers and browse available products for customers.  
* **Order Management**: Track orders in real-time, place and cancel orders, and manage order statuses.  
* **Feedback System**: Provide feedback on products or shops and respond to customer reviews.  
* **Payment and Checkout**: Secure payment processing and cart management.  
* **Blog Management**: Users can create, view, and comment on blog posts about food items and share their experiences with others.

**Feature Workflow**:

1. **Account Registration**: Users can create a new account or log in to an existing one.  
2. **Product Selection**: Browse available food items and select products to add to the cart.  
3. **Checkout**: Proceed with the payment, entering shipping details and selecting a payment method.  
4. **Order Tracking**: After placing an order, users can track the order status.  
5. **Feedback and Report**: Once the order is received, users can leave feedback  on the products and the service.  
6. **Blog Sharing**: Users can share their food experiences, write blogs, and interact with other users by commenting on posts.

**User Interface**:  
The app is designed with a user-friendly interface, making navigation easy with clearly labeled menus. Key sections such as orders, feedback, and product listings are easily accessible.

### **3.2 Workflow 1: Authentication Feature** {#3.2-workflow-1:-authentication-feature}

* #### ***Purpose of this Workflow:*** 

- The Authentication Workflow describes the process of user authentication, which is the first step to access the application. This workflow allows users to log in to their accounts securely by verifying their credentials (username/email and password). Once authenticated, users can proceed to use the application's features.

* #### ***Workflow Diagram:*** 

  ![][image2]


* #### ***Step-by-Step User Guide***

- ***Step 1: Open Login Screen***  
+ Navigate to the login screen of the application.  
+ This screen requires the user to enter a phone number in the "Số điện thoại" section and a password in the "Mật khẩu" section.  
+ After entering all the information about phone number and password, the user clicks on the "Đăng nhập" button to log into the system.  
+ If you forget your password, you can click the forgot password button to reset your password.  
+ If you do not have an account, click the “Đăng kí”button to go to Registration screen. ***(Step 2\)***

![][image3]

- ***Step 2: Navigate to Registration Screen***  
+ Navigate to the Registration screen of the application.  
+ This screen requires the user to enter a phone number in the "Số điện thoại" section   
+ After input phone number, click “Tiếp theo” to go to Otp Verification screen **(*Step 3*)**

![][image4]

- ***Step 3: Navigate to Otp Verification Screen***  
+ Navigate to the Otp Verification screen of the application.  
+ This screen requires the user to enter the Otp code in the "Otp Form" section after receiving the Otp code sent to their device  
+ Click ”Xác nhận” to go to Password verification screen ***(Step 4\)***

 ![][image5]

- ***Step 4: Navigate to Password Verification  Screen***  
+ Navigate to the Password Verification screen of the application.  
+ This screen requires the user to enter the email into “Email”section, enter new password into “Mật khẩu mới” section. After that, confirm your new password into “Xác nhận mật khẩu” section  
+ Click “Tiếp theo” to go to Register User profile screen ***(Step 5\)***

![][image6]

- ***Step 5: Navigate to User Profile Registration  Screen***  
+ Navigate to the User Profile Registration screen of the application.  
+ This screen requires the user to enter the profile information.   
+ Click “Lưu thông tin ” to go to complete register new account

![][image7]![][image8]

- ***Step 6: Navigate to Home Screen***  
+ Navigate to the Home screen of the application.

### **3.3 Workflow 2: Order Processing Feature** {#3.3-workflow-2:-order-processing-feature}

* #### ***Purpose of this Workflow:*** 

- The Order Process Workflow describes the steps a user (customer) takes to place an order, from adding products to the shopping cart to completing the purchase. This process also includes payment and order confirmation. This workflow is important to ensure that the ordering process is clear, smooth, and user-friendly.

* #### ***Workflow Diagram:*** 

  ![][image10]

* #### ***Step-by-Step User Guide***

- ***Step 1: Customers choose food***  
+ From the Home screen, the user selects a product to move to the Product Detail screen.  
+ In the Product Detail screen, users can edit the quantity they want to buy, select options, sizes and add to cart. ***(Step 2\)***

![][image11]![][image12]

- ***Step 2: User adds products to cart and edits***  
+ From the Product Detail screen, after the user selects the product, option, and clicks "Thêm vào giỏ hàng", it will be transferred to the cart screen.  
+ On the cart screen, users can continue to edit quantity, options, and select products by shop.  
+ Click "Buy" to proceed with purchasing the product, go to the check-out screen ***(Step 3\)***

![][image13]

- ***Step 3: User accesses the check-out screen***  
+ During the check-out screen, users can review order information.  
+ In the check-out screen, users can select a voucher ***(Step 3.a)***, choose a delivery method ***(Step 3.b)***, add information and notes to send to the shop.  
+ Finally, the user proceeds to choose 1 of 2 payment methods: "Chuyển khoản ngân hàng" or "Tiền mặt".  
+ If the user chooses "Chuyển khoản ngân hàng", they will be transferred to the QR payment page ***(Step 4\)***, and if they choose "Cash", they will be transferred to the My order screen ***(Step 5\)***.

  ![][image14]

  ![][image15]

  ![][image16]


- ***Step 4: User proceeds to pay for the order***  
+ Users will see the store's bank QR to make payment.  
+ After successful payment, the user must send a photo of the transfer proof.  
+ After uploading the proof, the user clicks on "Tôi đã thanh toán" and is transferred to the My-order screen ***(Step 5\)***.

  ![][image17]![][image18]

- ***Step 5: Customers, ShopKeeper, Shipper perform order control steps according to each status:***  
+ Chờ xác nhận: User orders are in the PENDING status, ShopKeeper can accept or reject the order ***(Step 5.a)***  
+ Đang chuẩn bị: The user's order is in "PROCESSING" status, ShopKeeper is preparing the order. Once the preparation is complete, the food photo will be uploaded by ShopKeeper. ***(Step 5.b)***  
+ Chờ xử lý: The User and ShopKeeper wait for the order to be confirmed by the Shipper. The Shipper has the right to accept or reject the order ***(Step 5.c)***  
+ Đang giao: Shipper delivers the food. After delivery, Shipper must take a photo after delivery. Users can click "Đã nhận được hàng" after receiving the order ***(Step 5.d)***  
+ Đã giao: After receiving the goods, users can evaluate the product and can also click to request a return.

![][image19]

![][image20]

![][image21]

![][image22]

![][image23]

- ***Step 6: Customer, Shopkeeper manage return issues:***  
+ On the "Đã giao" screen, the user clicks "Trả hàng" to select the reason for return, then must upload photo evidence.  
+ ShopKeeper can view return issue details, including evidence from Customer, ShopKeeper, Shipper ***(Step 6.a)***

![][image24]

![][image25]

### **3.4 Workflow 3: Blog Feature** {#3.4-workflow-3:-blog-feature}

**Workflow Diagram**

**![][image26]**

####  ***Purpose of this Workflow***

The **Blog feature** enables users to create, share, and manage posts within the application. Each blog post contains:

* Text content or image attachments (up to 5\) (required)  
* Metadata: created date, writer information

The workflow includes the following user actions:

* Create new blog post  
* View list of blogs  
* Edit or delete own blog  
* Comment on a blog  
* Edit or delete own comment

#### ***3.4.1 Add Blog Feature***

#### ***Step-by-Step User Guide***

#### **Starting Point: Blog List Screen**

* From the main blog screen, the user sees a feed of blogs and an input area at the top labeled: "Bạn đang nghĩ gì?"

![][image27]

#### 

#### 

#### 

#### 

#### 

####  **Step 1: Tap to Create a Blog**

* Tapping this area opens the **Add** **Blog Screen**.

![][image28]

####  **Step 2: Enter Content**

* User types the post content  in the multiline text input field.  
* The app supports Vietnamese input and emoji.  
* Tap the “Ảnh/Video” button.  
* Users can select up to 5 images from the gallery.

  ![][image29]

#### **Step 3: Submit Blog**

* Tap the **“Đăng”** button on the top right corner.  
* Form validation ensures that either content or image must be provided.  
* Upon successful submission:  
  * Blog is sent to the backend.  
  * The user is redirected back to the blog list screen.  
  * The new blog is added to the list (automatically or via API reload).

![][image30]

#### 

#### ***3.4.2 Edit Blog Feature***

 **Step-by-Step User Guide**

**Starting Point: Blog List Screen**  
 From the main Blog List screen, the user can see the list of available blog posts.

![][image31]

**Step 1: Open Blog Options Menu**

**![][image32]**

Tap the **"..."** button in the top right corner of a blog post. This will open a menu with options. Then tap on the "**Chỉnh sửa**" (Edit) button to open the Blog Edit screen.

* If the user is **not the author**, only the **Báo cáo** option will be visible.

**Step 2: Edit Content**

**![][image33]**  
The user can now modify the content of the blog. This includes:

* Editing the text in the content area.  
* Modifying the blog images (adding new images or removing existing ones).

**Step 3: Submit Blog**

**![][image34]**  
 After editing the content and images, tap the "**Cập nhật**" (Submit) button.

* The system will validate the content and images to ensure that either the content or an image is provided.  
* On successful submission, the blog is updated on the server.  
* The user is then redirected back to the Blog List screen, and the blog post is updated with the new content or images.

The updated blog will either be automatically refreshed on the Blog List screen, or if needed, the user may see the updated content after reloading the list. The new blog post (with the latest changes) will now be displayed.

#### ***3.4.3 Delete Blog Feature***

#### **Step-by-Step User Guide**

**Starting Point: Blog List Screen**

**![][image35]**  
From the main Blog List screen, the user can see the list of available blog posts.

**Step 1: Open Blog Options Menu**

* Tap the **"..."** button in the top right corner of a blog post. This will open a menu with options. Then tap on the "**Xóa**" (Delete) button.

* If the user is **not the author**, only the **Báo cáo** option will be visible.

 **Step 2: Confirm Blog Deletion**

**![][image36]**

* The user will be asked: **"Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa bài viết này không?"** (Are you sure you want to delete this post?).  
* The user can either confirm the deletion by tapping **Xóa** (Delete) or cancel by tapping **Huỷ** (Cancel). If the user decides not to delete the blog, they will return to the blog list without making any changes.

##### **Step 3: Blog Deleted Successfully**

![][image37]

* If the user confirms the deletion, the blog is deleted from the system.  
* The user is redirected back to the **Blog List Screen**.  
* The blog post will no longer appear in the list.

**Note:** Once deleted, the blog cannot be recovered. Ensure that the user confirms their action to avoid accidental deletion.

#### ***3.4.4 Manage Blog User Feature***

####  **Step-by-Step User Guide**

#####  **Starting Point: Blog List Screen**

![][image38]

On the main blog list screen, users will find an option labeled **"Quản lý bài đăng"** (Manage Your Blogs), typically located at the create blog section.

This option allows the user to manage all the blogs they have created.

##### **Step 1: Tap "Quản lý bài đăng" (Manage Your Blogs)**

When the user taps **"Quản lý bài đăng"**, they are redirected to the **Manage Your Blogs** page, where they can view a list of all the blogs they have created.

##### 

##### **Step 2: View All User’s  Blogs**

![][image39]

On the **Manage Your Blogs** page, users can see a list of their blog posts. Each blog will display the following details:

* Blog’s content and images  
* Date of creation  
* Options to edit or delete the blog  
* Users can tap on the blog open the **Blog Detail View**, where the user can see the full content of their blog.

**Step 3: Edit or Delete Blog**

Users can **Open Blog Options Menu** by tapping on the “**...**” icon on the top right corner of the blog. Once in the **Open Blog Options Menu**, users will have the option to either:

* **Edit the blog**: Tap the **"Chỉnh sửa"** (Edit) button to make changes to the blog content and images.  
* **Delete the blog**: Tap the **"Xóa"** (Delete) button to permanently delete the blog.

**Note:** All blogs displayed here will have the **Edit** and **Delete** options, as this page is already filtered to show only the user's blogs, so there’s no need to check for user ID.

##### **Step 4: Submit Updates or Confirm Deletion**

* If the user edits the blog, after making the necessary changes, they can tap **"Cập nhật"** (Update) to update the blog.  
* If the user decides to delete the blog, a confirmation dialog will pop up asking if they are sure about deleting it. After confirmation, the blog will be permanently removed.  
* Once the user has either updated or deleted a blog, they will be redirected back to the **User** **Blog List** screen. The list will automatically update to reflect any changes made. If a blog was deleted, it will no longer appear in the list.

#### **What Happens After Managing the Blog:**

* If the blog is **edited**, the changes are saved and displayed immediately on the blog list after the user submits them.  
* If the blog is **deleted**, it is permanently removed from the system and will not appear on the blog list anymore.  
* The **Manage Your Blogs** page is automatically updated to reflect any changes made, and the user is redirected back to the **Blog List Screen**.

#### ***3.4.5 Comment Feature***

####  **Step-by-Step User Guide**

#####  **Starting Point: Blog List Screen**

![][image40]

From the **Blog List** screen, the user can tap on any blog to view its details. The **comment feature** is available only within the **Blog Detail** screen.

##### **Step 1: Tap on a Blog**

To comment, tap on the desired blog from the **Blog List**. This opens the **Blog Detail Screen**, where the user can see the full content of the blog, including text and images (if available).

![][image41]

##### 

##### 

##### 

##### 

##### **Step 2: Enter Comment**

![][image42]

Once in the **Blog Detail Screen**, the user will find a text input field at the bottom of the screen labeled **"Viết bình luận..."** (Write a comment).

* The user can type a text comment in this field. The app only supports **text content** for comments, so users cannot upload images or videos in the comment section.  
* **Input Validation:** The comment text must not be empty.

##### 

##### 

##### **Step 3: Submit Comment**

![][image43]

After typing the comment, the user taps the **"Send"** icon (located next to the input field) to submit the comment.

* The comment will be posted and sent to the backend.  
* The system will show a **loading spinner** until the comment is successfully posted.

**Step 4: Comment Posted Successfully**

**![][image44]**

Once the comment is successfully submitted:

* The new comment will appear immediately below the blog post.  
* The comment count for the blog will be updated.  
* The user can now view the updated blog with the new comment. The system will not redirect to the **Blog List** screen after commenting; the user stays on the **Blog Detail Screen** to see their comment in place.

#### **What Happens After Commenting:**

* The user’s comment is displayed under the blog post.  
* The comment count will update automatically to reflect the new comment.  
* No refresh of the blog list screen is needed since the comment is posted directly to the blog's detail page.

#### ***3.5.6 Managing Voucher***

#### ***Step-by-Step User Guide***

#### **Starting Point: Shop homepage screen**

![][image61]

#### **From the Home Screen of your shop page, tap on the "Voucher" section. This will navigate you to the Voucher List screen, where you can manage all your vouchers.**

#### 

#### 

#### **Step 1: View the Voucher List**

![][image62]![][image63]

On the **Voucher List** screen, you'll see a list of all active vouchers. You can also swipe left and right to see voucher’s details such as:

* **Voucher code**  
* **Discount percentage** or **value**  
* **Usage status** (active, expired, or inactive)  
* **Startdate, Enddate**  
* **…**

#### Furthermore, you can apply **filters** to filter voucher by:

1. Tap on the **Filter icon** located at the top right corner of the screen.  
2. A filter popup will appear with the following options:  
   * **Voucher Code:** Enter the voucher code to search for specific vouchers.  
   * **Status:** Filter by the voucher’s status (Active, Expired, Inactive).  
   * **Discount Type:** Choose between Percentage or Fixed Amount.  
   * **Sort By:** Select the sorting option (e.g., Default or other sorting preferences).  
3. After selecting the desired filter criteria, tap the "Áp dụng" (Apply) button to apply the filter and update the voucher list based on the selected conditions.

   ![][image64]

You will also have the option to **add** a new voucher, or **edit**, **delete** for each voucher in the list.

#### **Step 2: Manage Voucher**

**Create a new voucher:**

1. Tap the **"+" button** at the bottom right corner of the screen to open the **Add Voucher** screen.  
2. Fill in the following fields:  
   * **Voucher Code**: A unique code for your voucher.  
   * **Discount Type**: Choose from **Percentage** or **Fixed Amount**.  
   * **Discount Value**: Enter the discount percentage or amount.  
     **Minimum Order**: Set the minimum order amount to use this voucher.  
   * **Quantity**: Specify the total number of vouchers available.  
   * **Customer Limit**: Set the maximum number of times a customer can use this voucher.  
   * **Start Date**: Select the starting date for the voucher to be valid.  
   * **End Date**: Choose the expiration date of the voucher.

After filling out the details, tap **"Tạo mã giảm giá"** to create and save the voucher.

![][image65]

#### **Edit an Existing Voucher**

1. In the **Voucher List** screen, find the voucher you want to edit.  
2. Tap the **edit icon (pencil)** next to the voucher.  
3. The system will open the **Edit Voucher** screen, where you can update the details of the voucher.  
4. After making the necessary changes, tap **"Cập nhật mã giảm giá"** to save the updated voucher information.

   ![][image66]

#### **Delete a Voucher**

1. In the **Voucher List** screen, tap the **delete icon (trash bin)** next to the voucher.  
2. A confirmation dialog will appear, asking if you are sure you want to delete this voucher.  
3. Tap **"Đồng ý"** to confirm the deletion, or **"Hủy"** to cancel and keep the voucher.

#### 

####

### **3.6 Workflow 5: Operator Feature** {#3.6-workflow-5:-operator-feature}

* #### ***Purpose of this Workflow:*** 

- This workflow would be helpful in your **User Manual** for explaining the **Operator Feature** and how operators manage accounts, shops, blogs, and reports. The operator has significant control over managing and monitoring the system, including deactivating accounts when necessary.

* #### ***Workflow Diagram:*** 

![][image75]

#### 

#### 

#### 

#### 

#### 

#### 

#### 

#### 

#### ***3.6.1*** **Operator Dashboard Page**

* #### ***Step-by-Step User Guide***

- ***Step 1: Operator Login page***  
+ Operator goes to the login page, enters email and password information, then clicks login to go to the dashboard page ***(Step 2\)***.

![][image76]

- ***Step 2: Operator Dashboard page***  
+ Operator view general statistics about users, shops, shippers, orders, blogs, reports

![][image77]

#### ***3.6.2*** **Operator Manage Account Page**

* #### ***Step-by-Step User Guide***

- ***Step 1: Operator Account List page***  
+ Operator can view the list of accounts on the system and can add other operators  
+ Operator can click on an account in the list to view information ***(Step 2\)***

![][image78]

![][image79]

- ***Step 2: Operator Manage Account Detail page***  
+ Operator can view account information of 1 user  
+ Operator can change user state

![][image80]

#### ***3.6.3*** **Operator Manage Shop Page**

* #### ***Step-by-Step User Guide***

- ***Step 1: Operator Shop List page***  
+ Operator can view the list of Shop on the system and can see the detail of shop  
+ Operator can click on “Xem chi tiết” in the list to view information ***(Step 2\)***

![][image81]

- ***Step 2: Operator Manage Shop Detail page***  
+ Operator can view the details of the selected Shop from the Shop list  
+ Operator can block Shop , view Shop product list, view Shop complaint list

![][image82]

![][image83]

- ***Step 3: Operator Manage Shop pending approval***  
+ From the list of shop, Operator can view Shops with PENDING status, after clicking, it will switch to view detailed information of the shop waiting for approval.  
+ At this page, users can approve the shop registration or reject the shop registration.

![][image84]

- Người giao hàng

#### ***3.6.4*** **Operator Manage Shipper Page**

* #### ***Step-by-Step User Guide***

- ***Step 1: Operator Manage Shipper List page***  
+ Operator can view the list of Shipper on the system and can see the detail of Shipper  
+ Operator can click on “Xem chi tiết” in the list to view information ***(Step 2\)***

![][image85]

- ***Step 2: Operator Manage Shipper Detail page***  
+ Operator can view shipper details  
+ Operator can block shipper by clicking "Block user"

![][image86]

- ***Step 3: Operator Manage Shipper Pending page***  
+ From the list of shipper, Operator can view Shipper with PENDING status, after clicking, it will switch to view detailed information of the Shipper waiting for approval.  
+ At this page, users can approve the shipper registration or reject the shipper registration.

![][image87]

####

#### ***3.6.5*** **Operator Manage App Page**

* #### ***Step-by-Step User Guide***

- ***Step 1: Operator Manage Banner page***  
+ Operator can view the list of Banner on the system and can see the detail of this banner  
+ Operator can click on the status section to hide and show the system banner.

![][image88]

- ***Step 2: Operator Manage Category page***  
+ Operator can view the list of Category on the system and can see the detail of this category  
+ Operator can click "Thêm danh mục" to add new category, and can edit and delete category

![][image89]

![][image90]

- ***Step 3: Operator Manage Order page***  
+ Operator can view the list of Order on the system and can see the detail of this Order  
+ Operator can view order details by clicking on each order.

![][image91]

![][image92]

- ***Step 4: Operator Manage Report page***  
+ Operator can view the list of Report on the system and can see the detail of this Report  
+ Operator can view report details by clicking on “Xem chi tiết”.  
+ In the report details screen, the Operator can view the evidence and record the report.

![][image93]

![][image94]
